ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels localized at distal tips and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity central region; high-contrast white mottling and focal spotting concentrated at the extreme left and right distal tips; radiating grey striations extending from the median notch toward the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 100-110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire boundary; presence of several deeper, irregular valleys and sharp peaks on the outer third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral S-curve trajectory characterized by initial convexity near the median notch transitioning into concavity toward the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters at the furthest extremities of both lobes; single high-intensity circular point-source located on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Horizontal linear pixel disruption visible on the lower-left ventral lobe; faint vertical light-grey linear striations distributed across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive white annular (ring-shaped) scar on the left-central lobe; solid white circular scar located slightly to the right of the median notch vertex; irregular depigmentation at the distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'O' shaped scar on the left lobe provides a highly unique geometric identifier.
